mlb.max_velocity_extreme_distribution.measurement_fix: Per pitcher with >=300 fastballs in the last 2 seasons: peaks-over-threshold fit of a generalized Pareto to fastball release_speed exceedances over the pitcher's 99th percentile (threshold u_i), shape xi_i constrained < 0 (finite endpoint) and shrunk to the pooled league xi with k=200 exceedances; p_i = P(speed >= 107.0 | fastball) = (n_exc/n_fb)*(1 + xi_i*(107-u_i)/sigma_i)^(-1/xi_i), zero if 107 exceeds the fitted endpoint. N_i = expected remaining fastballs = remaining appearances x fastballs per appearance (postseason appearances weighted by P(team reaches each round)). P(any) = 1 - prod_i(1 - p_i)^(N_i), with a sensitivity run that adds a shared park-offset random effect. Units: probability. As-of: daily, using only pitches dated before the as-of date.

mlb.outs_per_bf_dp_baserunning.measurement_fix: Outs per batter faced = sum over PA outcomes o of P(o) x E[outs_on_play | o, base-out state], where outcomes are K, BB, HBP, ground-out, fly/line-out, GIDP (2 outs), fielder's choice (1 out), reach-on-error (0), hit (0). Add baserunning outs (CS + pickoffs) per BF from the pitcher/catcher/runner model. Units: outs per batter faced. As-of: lineup post, data dated before the game.

mlb.scoreless_streak_survival.measurement_fix: Define the streak in outs. For each future outing j compute, by dynamic programming over the 24 base-out states within each half-inning, the probability S_j(k) of recording k consecutive outs with no run charged to the pitcher (counting all runs, and separately earned runs only). Transition probabilities from the pitcher's projected K%, BB%, HR/PA and BABIP vs the opponent lineup and park, each shrunk to league with k = 300 batters faced. Outs per outing from mlb.sp_hook_hazard_curve. P(reach N) = P(streak of N innings completed) summed over the outings remaining before season end by recursion on the carried streak. Add P(inherited runner scores) from bullpen strand rate. Units: probability. As-of: after each outing.

mlb.series_per_game_win_prob_vector.measurement_fix: For game k: logit p_k = a0 + b1 x D_team + b2 x D_sp x s_k + b3 x D_pen x (1 - s_k) + b4 x D_lineup + h_park, where D_team is postseason-weighted team rating difference in runs per game, D_sp is probable-starter projected RA9 difference weighted by expected starter innings share s_k (about 0.55), D_pen the availability-weighted bullpen rating difference, D_lineup the lineup-versus-hand wRC+ difference, and h_park the park-specific home term shrunk toward +0.035 (k = 300 games). mlb.triple_crown_joint_probability.measurement_fix: Within one league: contenders = top 10 in each of AVG (qualified, 3.1 PA per team game with the hitless-AB adjustment), HR and RBI. Simulate rest-of-season counts from projections (HR, RBI, H, AB, PA) with a multivariate model whose correlation matrix is estimated from 2000-2025 player-season residuals of rest-of-season stats against projection (shrunk to the pooled matrix with k = 30 seasons). 20k simulations; P(Triple Crown) = P(one player leads all three after applying qualification and tie rules per contract). Units: probability. As-of: daily.

mlb.truncated_season_go_no_go.assessment: Logistic on three indicators cannot be fitted: only two relevant events exist (2020 staged, 1994-95 cancelled), so coefficients are not identified and the 'prior 0.6 Beta(3,2)' dominates. Overlaps mlb.lockout_games_lost_scenario and mlb.lockout_precedent_reference_class.
raw_data: dated chronology of season-length proposals and decisions

mlb.wbc_national_team_strength.measurement_fix: Team run rate per game = sum over the expected lineup of projected runs created per PA (projection rate converted via league-equivalence factors, NPB 0.9, KBO 0.85, minor leagues by level, each shrunk to replacement with k = 200 PA) x expected PA, minus expected runs allowed = sum over rostered pitchers of projected RA9 x expected tournament innings share, where innings share follows the round pitch limits (verify the published limits for the edition; 2023 was 65/80/95 pitches) and relievers' appearances available. Convert run difference to game win probability with a log5/logistic fitted on 2006-2026 tournament games; simulate pools and bracket with the official tiebreaker. Units: probability. As-of: final roster announcement.

mlb.window_exposure_schedule.measurement_fix: N = number of team games in the window from the official schedule (adjust for postponement probability from mlb.forecast_precip_timing). Per-game participation p_g: hitters from mlb.playing_time_role start probability, pitchers from mlb.pitcher_rotation_slot_and_rest P(start on date) plus relief-appearance rate for relievers. P(healthy through g) = (1 - h)^g with per-game injury hazard h from mlb.injuries_pit shrunk to league by age/role (k = 100 player-seasons). P(at least one) = 1 - prod_g (1 - p_g x P(healthy through g)); multiply by (1 - clinched rest factor) from mlb.clinched_rest_policy after the clinch date. Units: probability. As-of: daily.

mlb.wins_to_date_and_games_remaining.assessment: State variables (wins, games remaining, run differential) and binomial-tail calculation are exact and point-in-time safe; the per-game probability comes from the talent posterior. Handles suspended/cancelled games. Mostly a state input rather than a predictor, overlapping mlb.season_sim_distribution inputs.
raw_data: daily standings with W-L and run differential
